title: Welcome to smuf Discussions! 🚀

## 👋 Welcome to the smuf community!

**smuf** is a self-hosted HTTP tunnel tool — like ngrok, but **yours**: no quotas, no limits, on your own server.

We're glad you're here. This is the place to connect with other smuf users, share ideas, and help each other out.

---

### 📋 Discussion categories

| Category | What goes here |
|----------|---------------|
| 💬 **General** | Anything tunnel-related — chat, random thoughts, meta |
| 🙏 **Q&A** | Questions about installation, configuration, or usage |
| 💡 **Ideas** | Feature suggestions, improvements, or changes |
| 🚀 **Show and tell** | Share what you've built, automated, or tunneled with smuf |

---

### 📖 Quick links

- [README](https://github.com/cosmind-rusu/smuf#readme) — install, usage, config reference
- [Issues](https://github.com/cosmind-rusu/smuf/issues) — bug reports and tracked features
- [Releases](https://github.com/cosmind-rusu/smuf/releases) — download binaries and changelogs

---

### 🤝 Community guidelines

1. **Be respectful** — everyone's here to learn and share
2. **Search first** — your question might already be answered
3. **Stay on topic** — keep discussions relevant to smuf and tunnels
4. **Share generously** — if you figured something out, help the next person

---

### 🐛 Found a bug?

Please [open an issue](https://github.com/cosmind-rusu/smuf/issues/new) instead of posting in Discussions. Bugs are easier to track there.

---

Happy tunneling! 🚀
